default/32243.htm.text: Broken Cargo Box: You see a large box that appears somewhat damaged.

Q00065_CertifiedSoulBreaker/32243-01.htm.text: Broken Cargo Box: Just as you are about to examine the box, you feel a strange presence and someone appears.

Q00065_CertifiedSoulBreaker/32243-03.htm.text: Broken Cargo Box: First, get rid of the person who is trying to take the box.
